title: Adum a Ɛkorɔn a Ɛwɔ Nkoko a Mframa Aprapra So no So
intro: Fa no sɛ anibuei a ɛrenya nkɔso a wɔde ahoɔden a ɛkorɔn ne adansi ho nimdeɛ a ɛso bi nni akyɛde no. Esiane sɛ na mpɔtam hafo yi traa nkoko akɛse a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa mu nti, ɛmaa mmeae akɛse a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛka wim no sɔree. Nanso ahantan gyee ntini, na wɔde animtiaabu hyiaa ɔfrɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔnsan nkɔ Allah nkutoo som mu. Nea edii akyi bae no da so ara yɛ kɔkɔbɔ a wɔde kɔ mframa no ankasa so.
clues: Na yɛyɛ ɔman a yɛwɔ tumi a yɛdii Nuh nkurɔfoɔ akyi baeɛ, a wɔhyira yɛn kɛseɛ ne ahoɔden kɛseɛ.
Yesisi abantenten a ɛkorɔn ne nkaedum wɔ beae a ɛkorɔn biara de yɛɛ agumadi ne ahantan ara kwa.
Yɛde yɛn hoahoaa yɛn ho, na yɛkaa sɛ hena na ɔyɛ den sen yɛn wɔ ahoɔden mu, na yɛyɛɛ atirimɔdensɛm a yenni mmɔborohunu.
Yɛpoo yɛn somafoɔ Hud berɛ a ɔfrɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnsom Allah nko ara, na ɔfrɛɛ no ​​mmerɛ ne ɔtorofoɔ.
Yedii kɔkɔbɔ no ho fɛw na yɛtwaa no mpoa sɛ sɛ ɔka nokware a, ɔmfa asotwe a ohunahuna no no mmra yɛn so.
Mframa a ano yɛ den na ɛyɛɛ kwae sɛee yɛn anadwo ason ne nnawɔtwe, na wogyaw yɛn ma yɛhwee ase te sɛ mmɛw nnua a ɛyɛ tokuru.

verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
